entries.title: Sarajevo moje moj jedini je svijet
O Cerco de Sarajevo, Pt. 1: Le Siège
O Cerco de Sarajevo, Pt. 2: Le Siège

lyrics.en:
For decades the Austro-Hungarian empire had been a 
powerful influence in the heart of Europe
Resting on a legacy, their house kept stability, order and peace 
But not everyone bowed to this power


In the summer of 1914 the archduke Franz Ferdinand of the empire
is visiting Sarajevo, unaware of the assassins awaiting him, and what will come


Two shots are fired and the archduke is dead 


The empire cannot let this go unpunished,
and the first declaration of war is made.


From a shot that would change the world
Tensions rise and a war is unfurled
Nothing like what had come before
It’s the war that will end all war!


Chaos and shockwaves spread from the Balkans across the globe
Alliances are put to the test, threats exchanged and armies are put on high alert
In the east the Russian Tsar is trying to calm the situation with his cousin
the Kaiser of Germany


But it is all in vain, the situation is out of control
War is unavoidable


The Battle of the Frontiers starts in August
as soldiers cross borders and bullets are fired in rage 


War begins

lyrics.ba:
Sarajevo, behara ti tvoga,
znaš li išta za dragoga moga?

Otiš'o je, već godina dana.
Ja ga čekam tužna, uplakana.

Dođi, dragi, milovanje moje,
pa utješi bolno srce moje.

Uzalud je i otac i mati
kad me, dragi, tvoj pogled ne prati.

lyrics.en:
Beneath your hills, where rivers flow,
 Oh Sarajevo, my heart will always go.
 Streets of stone, stories untold,
 A city's warmth, more precious than gold.
 

 The call to prayer, the church bell’s chime,
 Your voice is timeless, it echoes through time.
 Through shadows of sorrow, through mornings bright,
 Sarajevo, you are my guiding light.
 

 Sarajevo, my heart, my song,
 In your embrace, I’ve found where I belong.
 From Baščaršija’s charm to Trebević high,
 You hold my soul, beneath your sky.
 

 Through seasons of struggle, through winters cold,
 Your spirit stood firm, unbroken, bold.
 Each mountain whispers your name so sweet,
 Every sunrise dances on your streets.
 

 I walk your bridges, your love I feel,
 Every stone, every wound, begins to heal.
 Your people’s strength, their laughter, their tears,
 Sarajevo, you’ve carried my years.
 

 Sarajevo, my heart, my song,
 In your embrace, I’ve found where I belong.
 From Baščaršija’s charm to Trebević high,
 You hold my soul, beneath your sky.
 

 In the soft glow of sunset’s hue,
 Your beauty shines, forever true.
 Through war and peace, your spirit lives,
 Sarajevo, the love you give.
 

 So here I stand, in your warm embrace,
 My love for you, time can’t erase.
 Sarajevo, my heart’s true flame,
 Forever and always, I’ll sing your name.
